UX surfaceBoot surfaces: what the user sees first on each bundle.

Members

Overlay

Public wasm surface. RefCell interior-mutates around wasm-bindgen's &self/&mut self exports without JS-visible ceremony.

burn_set_colors

Burn sim data: four ink tints [core, mid, edge, scorch] × rgba.

  • @param {number} id
  • @param {Float32Array} flat

burn_set_dir

Burn sim direction: +1 burn, −1 rebuild (un-hover replay).

  • @param {number} id
  • @param {number} dir

burn_set_ink

Burn sim data: per-column ink occupancy bytes.

  • @param {number} id
  • @param {Uint8Array} ink

burn_set_letters

Burn sim data: letter table (f32×6 per letter).

  • @param {number} id
  • @param {Float32Array} flat

burn_set_stage

Burn sim stage — pushed per frame before frame: global progress 0..1 + jagged-edge amplitude in device px.

  • @param {number} id
  • @param {number} stage
  • @param {number} jag_amp

frame

One frame — the only per-tick entry point, and the whole reason the architecture works. Five stages, each chosen to cost the minimum the hardware allows:

  1. Drain input — replay every queued event once. Hover is recomputed only on move/down (up and wheel don't change what's under the pointer — skipping their hit_tests is a deliberate cost cut).
  2. Tick sims — burn particles advance in dt-space and emit quads into the shared buffer (one instanced draw covers ALL particles of ALL widgets).
  3. Upload — ONE write_buffer memcpy per frame; the instance buffer is grown geometrically (next_power_of_two) so steady frames never recreate it — allocation-free like the Vecs.
  4. Encode — clear once, then: quad pass → per-widget scissored draws (paint order = rect.y sort, mirroring DOM order) → text. One encoder, one render pass — state changes between widgets are pipeline+bind swaps, cheap driver commands.
  5. Present — mailbox mode drops stale frames rather than queueing latency.

dt is in SECONDS — see the module doc's dt-space note.

  • @param {number} dt

hover_group

The group under the pointer from the latest drain — the bridge reads it after frame to route click intents to the DOM router.

  • @returns {number}

init

Request adapter/device and configure the canvas surface. Called once from the bridge; failure propagates so the bridge falls back to DOM rendering.

  • @param {HTMLCanvasElement} canvas
  • @returns {Promise}

input_buffer_ptr

Pointer to the f32 input ring — JS writes records directly into wasm linear memory here. No copy, no call per event.

  • @returns {number}

input_meta_ptr

Pointer to the [head, tail] i32 meta pair — JS bumps head after each record write, Rust drains from tail during frame.

  • @returns {number}

install_font

Loads a route font (Raleway/Fira bytes) into the glyphon font db.

  • @param {string} family
  • @param {Uint8Array} bytes

constructor

Constructs an un-initialized overlay — init must follow before frame. Split because wgpu init is async on wasm32.

push_video_frame

Pushes a decoded video frame (WebCodecs → RGBA) into a media widget's texture — the video hot path: one write_texture, no bind-group rebuild, size changes recreate the slot.

  • @param {number} id
  • @param {Uint8Array} rgba
  • @param {number} w
  • @param {number} h

register_media

Registers a media widget rect — media quads draw through the textured pipeline; the id is shared with the slot table above. Same signature family as register_widget but no kind — media widgets are always textured quads.

  • @param {number} x
  • @param {number} y
  • @param {number} w
  • @param {number} h
  • @returns {number}

register_widget

Registers a widget region on the overlay. kind is a widgets::kinds discriminant; the rect is canvas CSS px. Returns a stable id for state pushes + teardown, 0 when the kind is unknown or the GPU isn't live (bridge keeps its DOM fallback).

  • @param {number} kind
  • @param {number} x
  • @param {number} y
  • @param {number} w
  • @param {number} h
  • @returns {number}

resize

Reconfigures the surface + text viewport after a canvas resize. scale is devicePixelRatio — text jobs stay in CSS px, glyphon rasterizes at device px so glyphs stay crisp at 120Hz+.

  • @param {number} w
  • @param {number} h

set_css_size

Tells the overlay the canvas's CSS size — the bridge calls this alongside resize(device px) so scissor math can convert widget rects (CSS px) into surface pixels.

  • @param {number} w
  • @param {number} h

set_text

Registers/replaces a mirrored text node. Called on DOM content change — not per frame. id is the bridge's stable slot for the DOM node; re-calling with an existing id updates in place.

  • @param {number} id
  • @param {string} text
  • @param {number} x
  • @param {number} y
  • @param {number} size
  • @param {number} max_width_px
  • @param {string} family
  • @param {number} r
  • @param {number} g
  • @param {number} b
  • @param {number} a
  • @param {number} bl
  • @param {number} bt
  • @param {number} br
  • @param {number} bb

set_widget_rect

Moves/resizes a widget region — the bridge calls this when the DOM rect it mirrors moves (layout shift, resize, scroll of the containing surface). The widget's own res uniform updates too so shaders keep their original px-space math.

  • @param {number} id
  • @param {number} x
  • @param {number} y
  • @param {number} w
  • @param {number} h

set_widget_uniform

Writes the widget's uniform block — raw f32s in the layout the widget's *.rs documents. Called per state change (per frame for time/progress, once per event for ripple/click stamps).

  • @param {number} id
  • @param {Float32Array} values

unregister_widget

Removes a widget — GPU resources drop with the handle.

  • @param {number} id

upload_flag_textures

Uploads both flag textures (RGBA8) and finishes the flag bind group. tex2 may repeat tex1 for non-split flags.

  • @param {number} id
  • @param {Uint8Array} rgba_a
  • @param {number} w_a
  • @param {number} h_a
  • @param {Uint8Array} rgba_b
  • @param {number} w_b
  • @param {number} h_b

upload_media_image

Decodes an image (jpeg/png/webp) in Rust and binds it to a media widget — decode runs in wasm, off the main thread, no createImageBitmap round trip. Returns false on decode failure so the bridge keeps the DOM (manifest-gated fallback).

  • @param {number} id
  • @param {Uint8Array} bytes
  • @returns {boolean}

write_skel_sheet

Writes the skeleton sheet — the per-rect vec4 fields the shader loops (rects/meta/sbase/sink, skeleton::RECT_FIELDS per rect).

  • @param {number} id
  • @param {Float32Array} values
